name: founder-letter
title: Founder letter
description: A letter from the person behind the company: dated, addressed to the reader, set for reading and signed with name, role and portrait.
docs: Pass the date (a label and an ISO dateTime), the place, a salutation and the paragraphs as children: plain p, ul, ol, blockquote, strong and a elements are styled, so Markdown output works as it is. signoff is the line before the signature and signer is a name, a role and a portrait URL; initials stand in until the portrait loads or when it fails. postscript is inline content that gets a paragraph of its own and is never collapsed; links and strong in it are styled like the body. title adds a subject line (an h2 unless you set headingLevel). The column is 38rem wide at a generous line height, and nothing about it is decorative. Pass labels to change the words that open the postscript.
